from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
from rdkit.Chem.EnumerateStereoisomers import EnumerateStereoisomers, StereoEnumerationOptions
import numpy as np

base = "c2cocc2[CH]1OC(=O)[CH]3CC[C](C)5[CH](C(=O)OC(=O)6)C[C]56[C](C)3C1"
mol = Chem.MolFromSmiles(base)

ringD = [9,10,11,12,21,22]  # C_d, C_e, J2, J1, M, C_c
furan = [0,1,2,3,4]
probes = {"furan":None, "C_l":7, "Me2":13, "Me1":23, "C4":14, "C1":18, "P":20}

def plane_normal(pts):
    c = pts.mean(axis=0)
    u,s,vt = np.linalg.svd(pts - c)
    return c, vt[2]

opts = StereoEnumerationOptions(onlyUnassigned=True, unique=True)
results = []
for iso in EnumerateStereoisomers(mol, options=opts):
    smi = Chem.MolToSmiles(iso)
    mh = Chem.AddHs(iso)
    params = AllChem.ETKDGv3()
    params.randomSeed = 42
    ok = AllChem.EmbedMolecule(mh, params)
    if ok != 0:
        continue
    try:
        AllChem.UFFOptimizeMolecule(mh, maxIters=400)
    except Exception:
        pass
    conf = mh.GetConformer()
    pos = np.array([list(conf.GetAtomPosition(i)) for i in range(mol.GetNumAtoms())])
    pts = pos[ringD]
    c0, n = plane_normal(pts)
    sd = {}
    for name, idx in probes.items():
        if name == "furan":
            p = pos[furan].mean(axis=0)
        else:
            p = pos[idx]
        sd[name] = float(np.dot(p - c0, n))
    # signs relative to furan
    s = np.sign(sd["furan"])
    rel = {k: np.sign(v)*s for k,v in sd.items()}
    results.append((smi, sd, rel, pos, mh))

print(f"embedded {len(results)} stereoisomers")
# filter: furan +; C_l -; Me1 -; Me2 -; C4 +
good = []
for smi, sd, rel, pos, mh in results:
    if rel["C_l"]<0 and rel["Me1"]<0 and rel["Me2"]<0 and rel["C4"]>0:
        good.append((smi, sd, rel, pos, mh))
print(f"matching pattern: {len(good)}")
for smi, sd, rel, pos, mh in good:
    print("GOOD:", smi)
    print("   signed dists:", {k: round(v,2) for k,v in sd.items()})
